sections.heading: Leonardo DiCaprio — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Leonardo DiCaprio was born on 11 November 1974 in Los Angeles, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Leonardo Wilhelm DiCaprio at birth and is publicly known as Leonardo DiCaprio.
Public records name his father, George DiCaprio and his mother, Irmelin Indenbirken.
He received his education at John Marshall High School, Los Angeles Center for Enriched Studies, UCLA Lab School and Young Actors Space.
He is recorded as speaking English, Italian and German.
